title: Bridging Digital Deception and Physical Fidelity: A Spatio-Temporal Attack on Cognitive Radars
abstract: arXiv:2610.27585v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As cognitive radars evolve towards the end-to-end processing of one-dimensional complex baseband sequences, deep networks face severe adversarial threats. However, existing attacks encounter dual limitations in practical electronic warfare: low cross-architecture transferability and severe vulnerability to physical channel distortions, which degrades their tactical reliability. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose a physical prior-driven Segmented Spatio-Temporal Attack (SSTA). First, a global-local feature decoupling segmentation mechanism interrupts the adversarial gradients' dependence on long-range sequence coherence, bridging the cross-architecture feature gap. Second, moving beyond static norm constraints devoid of physical semantics, we abstract channel distortions into differentiable spatio-temporal operators, integrating them into momentum iterations via an Expectation over Transformation (EoT) strategy. translated_title: 弥合数字欺骗与物理保真：一种针对认知雷达的时空攻击
translated_abstract: 随着认知雷达向一维复基带序列的端到端处理演进，深度网络面临严重的对抗性威胁。然而，现有攻击在实际电子战中遭遇双重局限：跨架构可迁移性低，且对物理信道失真高度脆弱，这削弱了其战术可靠性。为克服这些瓶颈，我们提出了一种物理先验驱动的分段时空攻击（SSTA）。首先，全局-局部特征解耦分割机制中断了对抗梯度对长程序列相干性的依赖，弥合了跨架构的特征鸿沟。其次，超越缺乏物理语义的静态范数约束，我们将信道失真抽象为可微的时空算子，并通过期望变换策略将其融入动量迭代过程。全面的跨……
tldr: 提出了一种物理先验驱动的分段时空攻击方法（SSTA），通过全局-局部特征解耦分割机制提升对抗样本的跨架构可迁移性，并将物理信道失真建模为可微时空算子以增强攻击在真实电子战环境中的战术可靠性。
en_tdlr: A physical prior-driven Segmented Spatio-Temporal Attack (SSTA) is proposed, which enhances cross-architecture transferability through a global-local feature decoupling segmentation mechanism and improves robustness to physical channel distortions by abstracting them into differentiable spatio-temporal operators integrated via an EoT strategy.
